description.value: Poparide is a peer-to-peer carpool marketplace (not a scheduled operator) with 112 BC locations listed (densest corridors include Vancouver-Whistler, the Island Highway, and Highway 4 to Tofino/Ucluelet). Drivers can optionally flag bike rack or bike space on their vehicle profile, but there's no platform-wide bike guarantee, fee, or boxing rule — space depends entirely on the individual driver, and riders are told to message the driver ahead of time to confirm room for a bike. Listings that take bikes show a bicycle icon in search results. Booking fee is roughly 20% of the trip price on top of the driver's posted seat cost. Because trips are driver-posted rather than scheduled, availability on any given day is not guaranteed.

Accommodates bicycles.detail: some Poparide listings state if they will take bikes
